question: Will OpenAI publicly announce GPT-6 by December 31, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if OpenAI makes a public announcement explicitly identifying a model as "GPT-6" on or before December 31, 2026 (UTC), via its official newsroom, blog, or research pages.
- "No": Wins if no such public announcement has been made by OpenAI on or before December 31, 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- A qualifying announcement must use the name "GPT-6" and originate directly from OpenAI (e.g., openai.com/news, openai.com/research, or an official OpenAI press release). Teaser posts, unconfirmed leaks, third-party reporting, or references to intermediate versioned models (e.g., GPT-5.x) do not qualify.
